messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick preflight — can we lock down the changelog & docs links for the Tue 10am PT go-live? Need: 1) final changelog snippet 2) doc permalinks 3) benchmark highlights 4) webinar CTA + inbound routing. Pinging eng for canary timing. @Tom
Tom (Eng): Can do. Canary planned Tue 9:30 PT for 30m. Will freeze model commits at 8:30 PT. Changelog PR ready at 7:50 — need marketing copy.
Sophie (Product): I posted a changelog draft in PR #432. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/432 — feel free to pull the 3-line blurb. Also adding release notes bullet.
Maya (Marketing): thanks! Can we get a docs permalink (stable) for the new routing section? Need for blog and email.
Alok (Growth): Webinar scheduled Wed 11am PT — landing page is up: https://go.redwood.ai/webinar-tuning. Inbound leads should route to growth@redwood.ai + tag 'announce-2790' in CRM.
DocsBot: created redirect: /docs/inference-routing -> /docs/inference/routing-v2 (permanent). Permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/routing-v2
Tom (Eng): Confirmed. We'll expose the docs link in canary. Also confirm fallback model variant in routing policy — set to 'small-latency-variant' if capacity > 90%.
Maya (Marketing): need a 1-2 sentence benchmark highlight (latency & cost) for the blog header. Can someone on infra give a sentence?
Tom (Eng): infra: 'In our benchmarks, tail latency at 512 tokens dropped 22% vs previous release while per-token GPU cost decreased ~18% with prefix caching.' Will refine numbers by EOD.
Sophie (Product): I'll craft the marketing-friendly line from that. Also: docs callout for rollback steps — need a short snippet for the release notes.
Maya (Marketing): inbound routing: is growth@ the only address? want lead enrichment + auto-assign. Alok?
Alok (Growth): growth@ gets captured by HubSpot, auto-tagging enabled. Can we add an alias announce-2790@redwood.ai that forwards and appends UTM info? Ops?
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for release/2026-03-24T09:30Z. Notifying eng-oncall.
Tom (Eng): ops, can you create alias and set header injection? @eng-infra / @eng-sre
Sophie (Product): timeline check: marketing send window Tue 10:15 PT (post-canary green), blog 10:30 PT, social threads 11:00 PT, webinar Wed 11am. Ok?
Maya (Marketing): sounds good. Action items: Tom — finalize changelog PR and confirm numbers by EOD (assigned). DocsBot/Docs — ensure permalink stable (done). Alok — set alias & CRM tag (assigned). Sophie — finalize copy + release-note snippet. I'll prepare email draft and social assets.
Alok (Growth): will set alias and confirm routing by 5pm PT.
Tom (Eng): changelog merged at 19:20 UTC (pushed). Changelog snippet: 'Improved serving latency and reduced per-token costs through adaptive caching and kernel tuning.'
Maya (Marketing): perfect. I'll use that line. Final ask — somebody run through the benchmark paragraph to make sure it's not overclaiming. @Tom @Sophie
Sophie (Product): reviewed — looks good, minor tweak: change 'reduced per-token costs' -> 'lower per-token inference costs' — I'll update.
Maya (Marketing): thanks team :tada: I'll post draft in #marketing-drafts and tag for approvals. Going to prep webinar slide deck with benchmark chart.
